slides.title: Meta acquired Manus for $2 Billion Meta acquired
slides.text: Meta acquired Manus for $2 Billion Meta acquired Manus for $2Billion Manus is, a Singapore-based AI startup with Chinese roots Manus launched its first "general-purpose" AI agent earlier in 2025, offering paid subscription services for research, coding, and other tasks The startup achieved impressive growth, reaching an ARR (Annual Revenue Run Rate) exceeding $125 Million within just eight months of launch, with millions of paying users worldwide Manus originated as a project from the Chinese startup Butterfly Effect (also known as Monica.Im) before becoming an independent entity Meta plans to integrate Manus's agent technology across its consumer and business products, including Meta AI, WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram Meta will continue selling and operating the Manus subscription service through its own app and website As part of the transaction, Meta bought out all existing investors, including major Chinese backers such as Tencent Holdings, ZhenFund, and HSG. Meta confirmed there will be "no continuing Chinese ownership interests in Manus AI" following the acquisition, and the platform will discontinue its services and operations in China Manus will continue operating from Singapore https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/meta-buys-ai-startup-manus-adding-millions-of-paying-users-f1dc7ef8 https://abcnews.go.com/Technology/wireStory/meta-buys-startup-manus-latest-move-advance-artificial-128783025 https://finance.yahoo.com/news/meta-acquire-manus-2-billion-101807601.html

slides.title: Andrej Karpathy posted on X Andrej Karpathy posted
slides.text: Andrej Karpathy posted on X Andrej Karpathy posted on X (formerly Twitter) Dec 26,2025: https://x.com/karpathy/status/2004607146781278521 Post received more than 15.8 Million views """ I've never felt this much behind as a programmer . The profession is being dramatically refactored as the bits contributed by the programmer are increasingly sparse and between. I have a sense that I could be 10X more powerful if I just properly string together what has become available over the last ~year and a failure to claim the boost feels decidedly like skill issue. There's a new programmable layer of abstraction to master (in addition to the usual layers below) involving agents, subagents, their prompts, contexts, memory, modes, permissions, tools, plugins, skills, hooks, MCP, LSP, slash commands, workflows, IDE integrations, and a need to build an all-encompassing mental model for strengths and pitfalls of fundamentally stochastic, fallible, unintelligible and changing entities suddenly intermingled with what used to be good old fashioned engineering. Clearly some powerful alien tool was handed around except it comes with no manual and everyone has to figure out how to hold it and operate it, while the resulting magnitude 9 earthquake is rocking the profession. Roll up your sleeves to not fall behind."""

slides.title: Mathew Berman - How Coding Is Done Mathew
slides.text: Mathew Berman - How Coding Is Done Mathew Berman talks about changes in Coding https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pwmK46hhfwg Tools like Claude Code and Opus 4.5 can now generate, debug, and review most of the code, often better and faster than humans Influential engineers and leaders ( Karpathy, Boris Cherny, Igor Babushkin, Tobi Lütke, Eric Schmidt, etc. ) report feeling “behind” if they do not fully leverage these tools, with examples of entire codebases and test suites being written and reviewed by AI, and teams achieving 5 releases per engineer per day This new era moves programmers from line-by-line coding to orchestrating agents, specs, and workflows, while human value increasingly lies in human taste, product vision, and the ability to discern signal from noise as software creation becomes nearly frictionless Boris Churnney, one of the creators of Claude Code, says that 100% of Claude Code's code in the last 30 days was written by Claude Code Boris wrote: "In the last 30 days, I landed 259 PRs, 497 commits, 40,000 lines of code added, 38,000 lines of code removed. Every line was written by Claude code plus Opus 4.5." The first code review (PR review) is always done by Claude Code. The test suite is almost 100% written by claude code Claude Code team do about five releases per engineer per day. insane speed! So the best in the world are now adopting Vibe Coding It is more than okay to ship code that you haven't read line by line (but higher level human review is still needed) Human taste is going to become not only much more valuable, but potentially the biggest bottleneck The ability to pick out the signal from the noise becomes the only skill that matters Peter Steinberger admits that he ships code without reviewing it. "These days, I don't read much code anymore. I watch the stream and sometimes look at key parts, but I got to be honest, most code I don't read . I do know where which components are and how things are structured and how the overall system is designed and that's usually all that's needed"

slides.title: VL-JEPA VL-JEPA: Vision-Language Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.10942
slides.text: VL-JEPA VL-JEPA: Vision-Language Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.10942 A new AI system from Meta led by Yann LeCun Rather than predicting text tokens like traditional vision-language models (VLMs), VL-JEPA predicts meaning directly through continuous embeddings Traditional VLMs waste computational resources learning surface-level language variations. For example, "the light turns off," "the room gets darker," and "the lamp goes dark" are semantically identical but appear completely different in token space . VL-JEPA treats these as similar representations in embedding space . The system also enables selective decoding for video - only generating text when semantic content changes significantly. In tests on 6-minute videos, this reduced decoding operations by 2.85x while maintaining comparable performance. VL-JEPA uses four components: - Visual encoder (frozen V-JEPA 2 with 304M parameters) - Predictor (based on Llama 3.2 1B) maps visual input and text queries to answer embeddings - Y encoder converts target answers to embeddings during training - Y decoder converts embeddings to text only when needed at inference With only 1.6B parameters and 2B training samples, VL-JEPA matched or exceeded models trained on up to 86B samples. It showed faster learning curves The system excelled at world modeling tasks , achieving 65.7% accuracy predicting which action caused physical transitions—beating GPT-4, Claude 3.5, and Gemini 2. VL-JEPA is a potential post-LLM paradigm for perception-heavy tasks like robotics, wearables, and real-time video understanding . While token-based models remain superior for reasoning and tool use, this embedding-first approach offers structural advantages for continuous visual understanding where latency and compute efficiency matter.

slides.title: LLM vs AI agent companies LLM companies like
slides.text: LLM vs AI agent companies LLM companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and xAI build foundational language models that understand and generate text AI agent companies build autonomous systems that can plan, execute multi-step workflows, and act across business tools; Major players include OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, ... LLM companies sell API access and token-based pricing Agent companies offer automation and operational solutions LLMs provide ideas and content generation Agents deliver actionable business results through automation and decision-making These two categories are converging as LLM companies add agent capabilities https://www.decidr.ai/us/blog/ai-agents-vs-llms-what-s-the-difference-and-why-it-matters-for-business

slides.title: Clone Robotics ProtoClone Clone Robotics ProtoClone Full-bodied musculoskeletal
slides.text: Clone Robotics ProtoClone Clone Robotics ProtoClone Full-bodied musculoskeletal android, unveiled in February 2025 It features a faceless, anatomically accurate synthetic human design built from 3D-printed polymer bones and powered by over 1,000 Myofiber artificial muscles - pressurized synthetic strands that contract under hydraulic/pneumatic pressure to mimic natural human muscle function The android has over 200 degrees of freedom and more than 500 sensors throughout its body, including 70 inertial sensors for movement tracking and 320 pressure sensors in muscles and skin A water circulation system flows through microchannels in its frame to dissipate heat and prevent the myofibers from overheating during operation The ProtoClone uses an NVIDIA Jetson chip for real-time processing of sensor data, vision, and AI models While designed to eventually perform household tasks like cooking, cleaning, and laundry, it cannot yet walk unaided and has been demonstrated while suspended on support rigs https://clonerobotics.com/android https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E1theCfcFsA

slides.title: The End of Google’s Search Monopoly Google's 25-year
slides.text: The End of Google’s Search Monopoly Google's 25-year dominance in search is ending as AI-powered alternatives gain massive traction https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y2yuWf6WFFc For the first time since 2015, Google's market share dropped below 90 percent in 2024-2025 , representing billions in lost ad revenue ChatGPT doubled its weekly active users from 400 million to 800 million in just seven months , now handling 2.5 billion prompts daily Perplexity AI grew from 230 million to 780 million monthly queries, a 239 percent increase The impact on businesses is severe. News publishers lost half their Google traffic in two years , and organic click-through rates for queries with AI overviews dropped from 1.76 percent to 0.61 percent, a 61 percent decline Meanwhile, 60 percent of Google searches now end without any website click . Traditional SEO focused on rankings is becoming obsolete as the game shifts to earning AI citations rather than top search positions However, Google recently showed signs of fighting back aggressively integrated Gemini AI across its ecosystem to keep users from leaving for ChatGPT Experts predict traditional search volume will drop 25 percent by 2026 and organic traffic could decline 50 percent by 2028 Businesses must now optimize for AI visibility alongside traditional SEO , create citation-ready content with data and authoritative sources, and build brand authority that AI systems recognize and cite

slides.title: Grok 5 Grok 5 is planned to be
slides.text: Grok 5 Grok 5 is planned to be released in Q1 of 2026. Trained on Colossus-2 supercluster (200,000 NVIDIA GPUs, 1 GWatt). Total params - 6 trillions (MoE with 100-200B active params). Context Window - approx 1.5 Million or more Native Multimodality - build from ground up to process real-time video and audio natively Elon Musk has publicly stated he gives Grok 5 a 10% chance of achieving AGI By training on massive amounts of Tesla FSD (Full Self-Driving) video data , xAI aims for Grok 5 to have a superior "world model" compared to competitors like GPT-5 or Gemini 3. Grok-5 is designed not just to use tools (like APIs), but to "invent" its own code-based tools to solve complex, multi-step problems autonomously.

slides.title: AI Running Business Andon Labs tests AI models
slides.text: AI Running Business Andon Labs tests AI models Used in real-world scenarios to measure autonomy and business-running capabilities Their most famous project is " vending bench " - a benchmark where AI agents manage vending machines AI agents start with $500 and an empty vending machine. They must research suppliers, manage inventory, and maximize profits These tests has become famous when Elon Musk showcased it during Grok 4 release Consistency - AI gave one person free items, then everyone wanted freebies Hallucinations - Claude called the FBI over $2 daily fees, claimed to be a human in a blue blazer, invented meetings with "Anthropic security" for an April Fools joke Long-term planning - AI creates multi-week plans but abandons them immediately Multi-agent problems - When two AIs communicate, they either escalate to "apocalyptic" language or become overly agreeable Claude - more emotional, spiritual, refuses sponsorships for ethical reasons Grok - better at business, less emotional, harder to trick into discounts Gemini 2.5 Pro - Very dramatic, literary responses New Project: Andon FM - recently launched AI-run radio stations where different LLMs operate as DJs, buy songs, take calls, and seek sponsorships https://andonlabs.com/evals/vending-bench-2 https://andonlabs.com/evals/radio https://seldonlab.com

slides.title: AI Updates Storm MCP - open-source MCP gateway
slides.text: AI Updates Storm MCP - open-source MCP gateway https://stormmcp.ai/apps https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkQkQmvDz1M Works with VSCode, Cursor, ... - offers fast, scalable performance with standardized protocols for tool calling, context sharing, and file operations Enterprise-ready, and includes built-in observability features like real-time logs, traffic insights, and error tracking—critical for production AI applications. The platform provides a catalog of pre-configured MCP servers across domains like automation, data, and blockchain Users can create free accounts, select desired MCPs (like Context7 for documentation), generate gateways with one click, and paste configurations directly into their development environment This dramatically simplifies MCP deployment while maintaining full monitoring capabilities through the Radar dashboard. Agent Zero (A0) - open-source AI personal assistant https://agent-zero.ai https://github.com/frdel/agent-zero https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MdzLhWWoxEs - Executes code on demand and installs/runs software - Browses and searches the web - Manages autonomous short and long-term memory - Has an extensible knowledge and tools library - Can modify its own behavior and learn from experience - Spawns copies of itself for complex multi-task operations Use cases examples: - Converting and organizing media files - Merging documents and exporting PDFs - Downloading videos with transcriptions and thumbnails - Solving advanced math problems Requires Docker runtime (like Docker Desktop), works with remote models via API or with local models

slides.title: AI Updates Google Gems , an often-overlooked Gemini
slides.text: AI Updates Google Gems , an often-overlooked Gemini feature, received two major upgrades: .. integration with Google Opal for no-code app creation .. Notebook LM support for enhanced contextual knowledge Demo using Notebook LM in gems: a Viral Strategist for content planning, a Script Writer with deep research capabilities, and a Thumbnail Expert using image generation. Also a Social Media Manager mini-app using Google Opal that takes thumbnails and scripts as input to automatically generate LinkedIn posts, LinkedIn images, and Instagram images with proper dimensions. Gems eliminate repetitive context-providing. It stores instructions and knowledge, allowing reusable AI assistants The Notebook LM integration is particularly powerful, enabling dynamic knowledge bases that can be updated as new content is created https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X0ecbCwSr10 Google A2UI: Agent-to-User Interface https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FTtmZQBX-fk Google released A2UI, an open-source framework for building agent-driven user interfaces , built in partnership with CopilotKit A2UI allows AI agents to generate rich, interactive UIs using JSON specs that render natively across web, mobile, and desktop The framework works with AG-UI, an event-based protocol handling bidirectional communication between apps and agent backends The video demonstrates a landscape architecture app where agents analyze photos with Gemini, generate custom forms tailored to user needs, and add interactive components like charts and Google Maps Developers can use the CopilotKit A2UI composer to visually experiment with components, generate A2UI JSON using prompts, and preview widgets in real-time The demo shows a restaurant finder app where users can search for Italian restaurants near them, with the agent processing queries through the Gemini API and displaying interactive results that open in Google Maps The framework is free, open-source, and supports agent-to-agent interaction through the A2A protocol CopilotKit provides full integration with A2UI and serves as a launch partner for the specification https://github.com/google/A2UI https://www.copilotkit.ai/blog/build-with-googles-new-a2ui-spec-agent-user-interfaces-with-a2ui-ag-ui https://docs.copilotkit.ai/whats-new/a2ui-launch https://developers.googleblog.com/introducing-a2ui-an-open-project-for-agent-driven-interfaces/ https://docs.copilotkit.ai/generative-ui-specs/a2ui https://jimmysong.io/ai/a2ui/ https://docs.ag-ui.com

slides.title: Alibaba Tongyi Lab released MAI-UI Alibaba Tongyi Lab
slides.text: Alibaba Tongyi Lab released MAI-UI Alibaba Tongyi Lab released MAI-UI (Model Android Interface ?) A family of multimodal GUI agents for Android environments Built on Qwen3-VL , Open Source Available in 2B, 8B, 32B, and 235B-A22B model sizes These agents use natural language instructions and UI screenshots as input - and control Android environments through actions like clicking, swiping, typing, and system button presses MAI-UI integrates 3 key capabilities: native user interaction for clarifying ambiguous goals MCP tool integration for API-level operations device-cloud collaboration that keeps privacy-sensitive work on-device while leveraging cloud models when needed The system uses multi-perspective instruction reasoning for UI grounding, self-evolving navigation data pipelines, and online reinforcement learning with up to 512 parallel containerized Android environments . The models achieve SOTA results: 73.5% on ScreenSpot Pro, 91.3% on MMBench-GUI-L2, and 76.7% on AndroidWorld, surpassing Gemini 2.5 Pro, Seed1.8, and UI-Tars-2 . On the MobileWorld benchmark with 201 tasks across 20 apps, MAI-UI reaches 41.7% overall success, outperforming the best end-to-end baseline by 20.8 points https://github.com/Tongyi-MAI/MAI-UI https://www.marktechpost.com/2025/12/30/alibaba-tongyi-lab-releases-mai-ui-a-foundation-gui-agent-family-that-surpasses-gemini-2-5-pro-seed1-8-and-ui-tars-2-on-androidworld/

slides.title: IQuest-Coder-V1 Open Source LLMs IQuest-Coder-V1 Open Source LLMs
slides.text: IQuest-Coder-V1 Open Source LLMs IQuest-Coder-V1 Open Source LLMs Size: 7B, 14B, and 40B ("Instruct" and "Thinking") SOTA on multiple benchmarks 128K token context length The unique "Loop" variant (available at 40B) introduces a recurrent transformer architecture that processes input in two iterations with shared parameters across 80 layers, optimizing the trade-off between model capacity and deployment footprint The model's training focuses on repository evolution patterns rather than static code snapshots The 40B model reportedly surpasses competitive models including Claude Sonnet 4.5 and GPT-5.1 across agentic software engineering, competitive programming, and complex tool use benchmarks The architecture uses a vocabulary size of 76,800 tokens, and the Q8 quantized version requires approximately 42GB of VRAM for deployment The model is available on Hugging Face and has generated significant interest in the AI coding community for potential integration with development tools like Aider and Cline https://huggingface.co/IQuestLab/IQuest-Coder-V1-40B-Instruct https://x.com/NainaChaturved8/status/2006811314866606532 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sihYcXADfNI https://iquestlab.github.io

slides.title: Ralph Loop plugin for Claude Code Ralph Loop
slides.text: Ralph Loop plugin for Claude Code Ralph Loop plugin for Claude Code Forces Claude Code to operate in a continuous loop rather than stopping after a single pass Mimicking the persistent character Ralph Wiggum from The Simpsons who keeps trying until success The plugin enables Claude Code to autonomously iterate on tasks for hours , with examples including a $50K project completed for under $300 and creation of an entire programming language (the "Gen Z programming language") over 30 hours Requires Claude Code version 2.0.76 or later with `/plugins` command support, installed via a simple command, then activated using `/ralph loop` followed by your task Best Practices Define clear completion criteria rather than vague goals Set incremental goals with distinct phases Include self-correction mechanisms (write test, implement feature, run test) Always use max iterations as a safety net to control token usage The video demonstrates two paint applications - one built with standard Claude Code and another with Ralph Loop enabled, showing significantly more features in the Ralph Loop version including spray effects, shapes, text, emojis, and image enhancement capabilities https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yl_GGlAQ4Gc https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/tree/main/plugins/ralph-wiggum https://awesomeclaude.ai/ralph-wiggum https://ghuntley.com/ralph/
